reason: Sol round 4 on the same two tooling scripts, still zero database surface. Five fixes: a line naming more than one version identifier is now reported as unknowable and checked not at all, because nearest-identifier binding still fabricates on 'API_VERSION and METHODOLOGY_VERSION are 2.0 and 1.1' and a fabricated finding is the worst outcome available here; the installer regex now requires an actual pip install invocation and understands --requirement, so `test -r file.txt` is no longer read as an installation and a long-form install is no longer missed; test imports are parsed with ast instead of a line regex, which picks up comma-separated aliases and pytest.importorskip literals -- the form this repo's dependency skips actually use; and the hard-link sidecar claim now fails closed instead of falling back to a non-exclusive os.replace, since a weaker guarantee that looks like the strong one is the pattern this whole change exists to remove. All six pre-impl protocol steps remain inapplicable for the reasons recorded in the first marker: no table, no join key, no SQL, no pending-set sentinel, no cross-system entity naming, no column feeding a typed model.
